clue.text: Uptight plonker, Conservative and extremely horny

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremes of the next word, its very first and very last letters

blocks.note: a plonker is British slang for a fool, a twit
C is the standard abbreviation for Conservative
the first and last letters of horny

explanation.surface: A rude sketch of an edgy, randy Tory idiot, in Private Eye's usual style.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone twitchy is nervous and jumpy, which matches being tense or uptight.

clue.text: Protection for members in deep water

definitions.text: Protection for members in deep water

blocks.clueFragment: Protection for members in deep water
blocks.note: surface reading: some safeguard for club or party members who are in trouble
setter's reading: members are limbs, here legs, kept dry by tall waterproof boots worn by anglers

explanation.walkthrough: 'In deep water' suggests members in trouble, but it is literal: anglers wade into rivers in high rubber boots.
explanation.definitionFit: Waterproof thigh-high boots or trousers keep an angler's legs dry while standing in a river.

clue.text: Rise above rants about Corbyn's prime goal

indicators.note: about suggests the word rants is turned round and jumbled
prime means first, so only the opening letter of Corbyn is used

blocks.note: the letters of rants rearranged
first letter of Corbyn
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: A political jibe that Jeremy Corbyn, former Labour leader, hopes to rise above ranting.
explanation.definitionFit: To transcend something is to go beyond or surpass it, a verb meaning to rise above.

clue.text: see 23ac.
Clegg packed with sex and power? Challenge that in some detail!

indicators.note: something packed with other things holds them inside, so Clegg's name wraps round what follows

blocks.note: Nick Clegg, former Liberal Democrat leader and deputy prime minister
it is a common slang word for sex
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.surface: A cheeky question about Nick Clegg's love life, followed by a dare to argue the small print.
explanation.definitionFit: To nitpick is to quibble over tiny points, disputing something on minor details.

clue.text: Location of pig ritual performance ends with a flourish

indicators.note: ends asks for the closing letter of each of the two words just before it

blocks.note: a pig lives in a sty
final letters of ritual and of performance

explanation.surface: A strange ceremony involving a pig is staged and finishes theatrically.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in style means doing it elegantly and showily, with flair or a flourish.

clue.text: Penis tip that hurt, following posing?

definitions.note: the answer is the word that follows posing in the phrase posing pouch

indicators.note: the tip of a word is its very first letter

blocks.note: first letter of penis
what you cry out when something hurts

explanation.surface: A painful mishap below the belt while striking a pose.
explanation.walkthrough: A posing pouch is the skimpy garment bodybuilders wear on stage, so the definition is the word that comes after posing.
explanation.definitionFit: Completing the phrase, a posing pouch is the tiny covering worn by male bodybuilders and strippers.

clue.text: Material offered by Conservative, burnt-out stuff, nothing more

blocks.note: C is the standard abbreviation for Conservative
ash is what remains after burning
mere means nothing more than, as in a mere child

explanation.surface: A Tory hands out worthless leftovers and nothing else.
explanation.definitionFit: Cashmere is a fine wool fabric from goats, so it is a cloth or material.

clue.text: With Nigel finally going, perfect conceit!

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of Nigel
going means departing, so that letter leaves the word it sits in

blocks.note: last letter of Nigel
ideal means perfect

explanation.surface: A cheer that Nigel Farage is leaving, which would be just perfect.
explanation.definitionFit: A conceit, in its older sense, is a notion, fanciful thought or clever concept.

clue.text: Paper covering for poor US GIs taking care not to be identified

definitions.text: taking care not to be identified

indicators.note: poor means in bad shape, so the letters of US GIs are knocked out of order
a covering goes round something, so the paper wraps round the jumbled letters

blocks.note: the Indie is the nickname of The Independent newspaper
the letters of US GIs rearranged

explanation.surface: Newspaper reporting on hard-up American soldiers who are trying to stay anonymous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paper covering' reads as a wrapper, but it names a newspaper, The Independent, known in Britain by a short nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in disguise has altered their look precisely so they will not be recognised by others.

clue.text: Ridiculously powerful businessman, syndicate boss, a hollow loud-mouthed fake

indicators.note: something hollow has its inside removed, leaving just the outside letters

blocks.note: a don is the head of a Mafia crime syndicate
taken as written
loud-mouthed with everything between its first and last letters emptied out
to trump up a charge is to fake or fabricate it

explanation.surface: A savage profile of a mighty mogul as a gangster, an empty braggart and a phoney.

clue.text: 11's ultimate regular club engagement? How awful if he were to get it!

definitions.text: How awful if he were to get it
definitions.note: a cryptic pointer rather than a synonym: the prize Trump was then chasing

indicators.note: ultimate means final, so only the last letter of entry 11 is wanted

blocks.note: last letter of the answer to 11-down
a DJ or band with a residency plays at the same club regularly

explanation.surface: Musing on a regular gig at a nightclub, then a shudder at the thought of a certain man winning.
explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle dates from the 2016 US election campaign, when Trump was seeking the White House.
explanation.definitionFit: The office of head of state in the US was what this candidate hoped to win, to the setter's dismay.

clue.text: Border control centre withdrawn from "those people"

indicators.note: centre picks the middle letter of the word control
withdrawn from means taken out of, so that letter is removed from the following word

blocks.note: the middle letter of the seven-letter word control
them is the pronoun for those people

explanation.surface: Immigration officers are pulled out of an area among outsiders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Border control' reads as one phrase, but border is the definition and control supplies its middle letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A hem is the folded edge of cloth, so an edge or border of a garment.

clue.text: (& 28ac.) Aspects of a literary body minded to be contrary

definitions.text: Aspects of a literary body minded to be contrary

blocks.clueFragment: Aspects of a literary body minded to be contrary
blocks.note: surface reading: a book group or literary society that loves to argue
setter's reading: one body with two minds pulling in opposite directions, the two sides of a single fictional man

explanation.walkthrough: 'Literary body' suggests a society of writers, but it is one person in a Robert Louis Stevenson novella.
explanation.definitionFit: Stevenson's doctor and his evil alter ego are two opposed personalities sharing one physical frame.

clue.text: Swear alternative Tory leader is Labour

or introduces an alternative
first letter of Tory

explanation.walkthrough: Capitalised Labour looks like the party, but here it simply means hard work.

clue.text: Independent hack's spare prick

blocks.note: spare and free both mean unoccupied or available
to lance a boil is to prick it

explanation.definitionFit: A freelance is a self-employed writer who works for several outlets rather than one paper.

clue.text: After a drink, almost nothing on – which was worth something in olden times

taken as written

clue.text: Johnny's party act: getting married

blocks.note: Con is short for the Conservative Party
to do is to act
M is the abbreviation for married

clue.text: Was the boss bloke "Silver Balls"?

clue.text: Token party nominees

second meaning: in US politics, the list of candidates a party puts forward

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an admission voucher and, in American usage, a party's slate of election candidates.

clue.text: I say, Rebekah's leader screwed up, etc – do some editing!

first letter of Rebekah
the letters of etc rearranged

clue.text: (& 4dn.) When things just get worse and worse – 24/7 in 11's case?
